description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Braum''' leaps into the air and slams his shield into the ground, creating a fissure from the impact that travels forth in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies within its path as well as those around '''Braum'''.
description.text: Active: Braum leaps into the air and slams his shield into the ground, creating a fissure from the impact that travels forth in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies within its path as well as those around Braum.

description2.raw: The first target hit is [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocked up]] for at least 0.6 seconds, increased if they are further away from '''Braum'''. All other enemies hit are [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocked up]] for 0.6 seconds.
description2.text: The first target hit is knocked up for at least 0.6 seconds, increased if they are further away from Braum. All other enemies hit are knocked up for 0.6 seconds.

description3.raw: A field of ice is created along the fissure's path, lasting for 4 seconds and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] enemies within the area every 0.25 seconds. The field disappears after the duration ends in the same order and speed it was created with.
description3.text: A field of ice is created along the fissure's path, lasting for 4 seconds and slowing enemies within the area every 0.25 seconds. The field disappears after the duration ends in the same order and speed it was created with.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
150 / 200 / 250 / 300 / 350 (+ 60% AP)

leveling2.raw:
'''Maximum Knock up Duration:'''
1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds
